# Blueprint port-turn regression

`blueprint-port-turn.json` is the smallest retained initial factory in the former
32-case evaluation cohort (generation seed 232700017, 6,347 bytes). It is kept as
a deliberate regression fixture because the older crossing fixture has straight
port approaches and cannot expose incorrect replacement of an original route
heading with the facility boundary normal. The game catalogs remain external.

The complete validated witness is needed to check admission and no-op export;
keeping only a heading would miss the full-layout regression. It is copied
without changing geometry from the protocol identified by SHA-256
`fb6061b7513d3d558eb6beb21b0ab1a1346978d8c42d24023e820cb2b31b7531`.
The corresponding run source remains retained outside tracked source directories.
